items.title: Persist an exact RED for TEST-transition fresh-PASS reuse
items.context: Convert the isolated reproduction into a production-path test using the real local CLI sequence. It must prove current code reaches commandExecutions=0 yet returns infra_failure solely because trusted lifecycle metadata is dirty; retain a negative control for pre-existing human/external dirt.

happy.desc: A production-path regression harness drives the local worktree CLI through a real REVIEW-to-TEST story_advance followed immediately by mandatory validate, without an intervening git add/commit, and on the current implementation proves validation selected the fresh PASS (disposition reused, commandExecutions=0) but returned infra_failure solely with canonical-pass-persistence-failed naming lifecycle-generated process-events metadata; the harness is committed while still RED before the production fix.

edge.desc: The RED fixture isolates counters and scratch artifacts outside the fixture repository and asserts no configured validation command executed, so repository pollution by the harness cannot masquerade as the product failure.

The fixture records the exact pre-validate git status and the post-failure dirty rows, demonstrating the offending managed metadata was absent on command entry and was created by the authorized TEST transition rather than pre-existing dirt.

adversarial.desc: A negative control with a pre-existing direct or human-authored managed-metadata modification is refused before reuse persistence and is never reclassified as trusted merely because its path or event type resembles canonical lifecycle output.

The regression fails if the product invokes any full validation command, silently commits arbitrary dirt, or reports PASS despite a persistence failure; only the exact zero-command infra_failure signature qualifies as the intended pre-fix RED.

items.title: Make trusted lifecycle metadata and reused PASS persist atomically
items.context: Differentiate canonical metadata created by the immediately preceding authorized lifecycle flow from pre-existing or untrusted dirt, and include only admissible generated paths in the isolated CAS/closeout writer transaction. Never allow arbitrary dirty files or prose/event-type spoofing to become trusted.

items.title: Verify one-shot convergence and fail-closed security boundaries
items.context: The real TEST transition followed by mandatory validate must return PASS, disposition reused and commandExecutions=0 in one invocation with a clean tree. Human confirmation, forged event, malformed receipt, unrelated dirty source/config, concurrent HEAD change and writer failure must remain rejected or roll back safely.
